title: Filed Billing Relativities — Endorsement Premium Billed Ahead by Financial Responsibility Certificate (Installment Payment Plans)
content:
**Exhibit.** Company's own filed percentages, **Installment Payment Plans**, applicable to draft notices on the Cardinal Point Monthly EFT Plan and the Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan billing an Owner Auto Policy term.

A draft notice adds to its premium a percentage of the endorsement premium not yet billed — every additional premium transaction booked on the Owner Auto Policy term, less the premium the plan's installment invoices have billed beyond the scheduled installment premium once for each of them — according to the certificate the term is written to back:

| Owner Auto Policy term's financial responsibility filing | Percentage of the endorsement premium not yet billed added to the notice |
|---|---|
| FR-44 (the term is written to back an FR-44 certificate) | 5 percent |
| SR-22 (the term is written to back an SR-22 certificate) | 2.5 percent |
| none (the term backs no certificate) | nothing |

The certificate is read from the Owner Auto Policy term's own record of the financial responsibility filing it is written to back.

*Hypothetical reading.* On a notice where the endorsement premium not yet billed is 240.00, a term written to back an FR-44 certificate takes 5 percent of 240.00, which is 12.00; one written to back an SR-22 certificate takes 2.5 percent, which is 6.00; a term backing no certificate takes nothing under this exhibit.
